verdict.rationale: a-Shell documents its own programmatic surfaces: Apple Shortcuts actions (Execute Command, Put File, Get File) and an optional built-in HTTPS relay whose POST /run endpoint accepts a command line with an X-Token header. Both are local-only, the relay is off by default and meant for trusted networks, and the endpoint is described only in README prose. Probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt returned 404. missing for 10: formal API reference or OpenAPI spec, remote/cloud API, API versioning and changelog, isolated test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: POST /run takes a UTF-8 command line as its body and requires Content-Length and X-Token
`Execute Command`, which takes a list of commands and executes them in order.
`Put File` and `Get File` are used to transfer files to and from a-Shell.
